description: Get the full record of one listing found with search_listings. Returns everything in the search result plus the seller's description, color, material, minimum offer, the on-chain provenance record (fingerprint and what it does and does not prove), when it was listed, and how to buy it: the checkout url and the payment methods it accepts. Use this before pricing or buying a piece. Fails with a clear message if the id does not exist or the piece is no longer for sale.

id.description: The listing's id, exactly as returned in the `id` field of search_listings results (a slug such as 'kaws-x-sesame-street-water-parade-elmo-figure').

name: get_listing
title: Listing details
